name: 100K Express
tagline: Uzbek super-app for intercity taxi seats, parcel delivery, cargo and vehicle hire
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team for 100k.uz

scenes.title: One app for four transport services
scenes.body: Onboarding introduces parcel mail, intercity passenger seats, cargo and vehicle hire before sign-in.

scenes.title: Intercity rides at the rider's price
scenes.body: Riders post the route, seats and a per-seat offer; drivers browse open requests and tap to accept.

scenes.title: Parcels between regions, insured
scenes.body: Choose car, truck or on-foot delivery, set the courier fee and insure the parcel at 0.5% of its value.

scenes.title: Cargo loads and vehicles for hire
scenes.body: Shippers post weight, goods and price; owners list cars and special machinery by the day, hour or km.

scenes.title: Wallet and courier sign-up
scenes.body: Main and deposit balances, a Payme or Click top-up screen and a courier application with document photos.
